_meta.description: Single source of truth for brand identity. The visual mark + wordmark live as a hand-designed master at /logo.svg; `npm run brand:build` derives the seven public variants (mark, mark-mono, horizontal, stacked, wordmark, app-icon, plus the full master copied through). EDIT this file to change the app name, tagline, colors, or email domain — and EDIT /logo.svg to change the actual logo artwork. Variant SVGs in /public are regenerated automatically on dev/build via the predev/prebuild hook.

name: CultureFlow
shortTag: Events for the South Sudanese community
description: Discover and host events for South Sudanese — at home and across the diaspora. Tickets, discovery, and connection in one place for our tribes, clans, churches, and communities.
_markNote: Mark = warm savanna amber (#D9930F) horns from the hand-drawn /logo.svg. Wordmark = 'CultureFlow' rendered as live SVG text in Nile blue (#1B3A85), Inter weight 500. Compact lockup: the mark visually leads, the wordmark sits centred beside it. The savanna amber #F5B800 stays available as a brighter accent for buttons / highlights / pill badges. /scripts/build-brand-svgs.mjs derives every public SVG variant from /logo.svg + these colours.
